name: Crypto Tax Calculator
description: Calculates cryptocurrency tax obligations by tracking cost basis and transaction history across multiple chains and exchanges.
author: JackTheGit

read.description: Scans on-chain EVM wallet histories (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism) via Blockscout endpoints.

parameters.chain: string — e.g. ethereum, polygon, arbitrum, base, optimism
parameters.address: string — the wallet address to scan

read.description: Pulls historical trade logs from Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, and 100+ CEXs via ccxt.
Runs FIFO/LIFO lot matching with short-term vs. long-term capital gains splits and ERC-20 token support.

parameters.currency: string — the fiat currency for gains reporting, e.g. USD
